name: Comfort and Warmth
source:
Comfort and Warmth is a sweet and spicy visual novel which captures the feeling of a loving relationship with a partner who enjoys taking care of you.

Step into the shoes of a woman in the early stages of a relationship with a man who's in it for the long haul. She might not have job security, benefits, or the respect of her bosses, but she does have a partner who'll support her through thick and thin. He'll lift her up when she's feeling down, and on her toughest days, he's always there to look after her.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3449190/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Comfort and Warmth》是一部又甜又辣的视觉小说，它捕捉到了与喜欢照顾你的伴侣之间的爱的感觉。

站在女人的立场上，与处于长期关系的男人建立关系的早期阶段。她可能没有工作保障、福利或老板的尊重，但她确实有一个会同甘共苦支持她的合作伙伴。当她情绪低落时，他会鼓励她；在她最困难的时候，他总是在那里照顾她。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3449190/]Steam[/url]]
